backup.production_rule: Monthly bill reminders and bill payment in the Staff app (Lloyd 2026-11-20; contract docs/s127/CONTRACT-B-APP.md over CONTRACT-B.md Addenda 1 and 3; the actor is the signed-in staff user, no Telegram). Adds the app_settings row bill_schedule (only if absent; account numbers, payee name, number and note are empty strings) with two restrictive policies hiding that key from anon and every account but manage_staff; table utility_bills (RLS on, service_role only; paying_by and paid_by are auth user ids); 13 internal functions with no grants (bill_step_v1 core, bill_due_open_v1 opener, bill_daily_v1 daily job and the config and entry helpers); eight functions granted to authenticated only, each gating on auth.uid() and the role inside the body: bill_pay_open_v1, bill_pay_settle_v1, bill_pay_cancel_v1, bill_pay_skip_v1, bill_proof_v1 (approve_payment), bill_schedule_get_v1, bill_schedule_set_v1 (manage_staff), and today_bills_v1 (read_operations); a pg_cron job bill-daily-0800-manila (00:00 UTC) calling bill_daily_v1() (active properties only; a property that raises is skipped with a warning and does not stop the others), which opens bills from the floor month 2026-11 (October 2026 stays closed) and writes one ops_notices reminder per bill, re-dated daily until paid or skipped; extends transactions_source_check with 'bill' behind a guard (55000 on an unknown literal; NOT VALID, then validated); and replaces today_bills_v1 in place behind an md5 guard (lane A body f7cfd2f8ddd001229df63601b636c5b7, this release 70302291441c8493c622ae66befe6b79; 55000 when the live body is neither) adding the key 'due' with can_pay. Every existing key, grant and search_path of today_bills_v1 is unchanged. It also replaces staff_pay_admin_settle_v1 in place behind an md5 guard (S81 body f1909b8b1a166188797a7d28688664fb, this release 9035d0051294fcef4ff538fd65517524; 55000 when the live body is neither): the body is unchanged except that a screenshot whose sha256 already paid a bill is refused with its existing duplicate_proof reason; grants, owner, security definer and search_path are unchanged. This release ships in-app notices only: no push is sent. Account, payee and note settings are read only by bill_pay_open_v1 and bill_schedule_get_v1; bill_json_v1 and every other reply carry none of them.

rollback.safe_until: Until a bill is marked paid or a transaction with source 'bill' exists: the rollback script refuses after that, because it would drop ledger evidence. Before then: today_bills_v1 goes back to the lane A body, staff_pay_admin_settle_v1 goes back to the S81 body (md5 f1909b8b1a166188797a7d28688664fb), the new functions, table, policies and setting are removed, and transactions_source_check loses 'bill'.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261128_s127_bill_reminders.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; today_bills_v1 must be back to md5 f7cfd2f8ddd001229df63601b636c5b7, staff_pay_admin_settle_v1 to md5 f1909b8b1a166188797a7d28688664fb and the cron job bill-daily-0800-manila gone. Roll the Staff app back first (it calls the bill_pay_*, bill_proof_v1, bill_schedule_* functions and the due key).

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. Old staff builds keep working: today_bills_v1 only gains the key due, which an old build ignores; the new functions are called only by the new Staff app build.
